## 05cfa1aabb8a

**Reproduced defect — palette-only shortcut.** With generator SHA-256 `8a2c11533142c1093cc880f1990bf7f498d63f2122e791dc4a472be16404ec8a` and rule hash `f18089b5b656`, the rival “collect the colors present in the template panel, then mark every board cell having one of those colors” fits all 3 usable canonical labeled pairs and 60/60 generated samples (20 per easy/medium/hard band). It ignores shape, location, and orientation entirely.

The exact retained counterexample adds one template-colored board cell at `(0,0)` to a generated `plain` draw. `self_check` still returns no errors. The Racket rule marks `(1,0)`, `(2,0)`, `(3,0)`, and `(4,0)`; the rival additionally marks `(0,0)`. This intervention is validator-accepted but outside the current sampler invariant, because the sampler avoids template-colored decoys. Evidence: `checks/audit/05cfa1aabb8a/probe/counterexample.json`, with supported execution receipt `checks/audit/05cfa1aabb8a/probe/racket.json`.

The source-bound before battery is independently unhealthy: 7 green, 2 advisory, and 3 failed stages (`lint`, `defect_lint`, `override`), recorded in `checks/audit/05cfa1aabb8a/battery/checks/05cfa1aabb8a_before_battery_summary.json`. The failures include a missing `RULE_HASH`, a degenerate `no_match` texture/domain overlap, declared override rejections, undeclared multi-axis incompatibilities, and silent acceptance of an unknown override key. Audit only; no source files for this task were changed.

## 05cfa1aabb8a

**Reproduced defect — palette-only shortcut.** Audited generator SHA-256:
`8a2c11533142c1093cc880f1990bf7f498d63f2122e791dc4a472be16404ec8a`;
declared rule hash: `f18089b5b656`. The target source was not modified.

The intended transformation uses the small template panel to select matching
shapes on the larger board. The current sampler, however, never places a board
decoy that has a template color but a nonmatching shape. Consequently the much
simpler rival “mark every board cell whose color occurs anywhere in the template
panel” fits every usable labeled canonical pair tested (3/3) and every generated
sample tested (60/60: sample indices 0–19 in easy, medium, and hard).

`checks/audit/05cfa1aabb8a/probe/report.json` is the source-bound reproducer. It
also contains a validator-accepted counterexample generated from seed 1,
medium/plain: one template-colored board cell is added at board coordinate
`[0,0]`. `self_check` returns no errors. The canonical Racket output leaves that
cell 0 because its shape does not match; the palette-only rival writes 8 there.
The input SHA-256 is
`c78e7c4ac3cae0ccdc5bf866d18da68e024587348d092355eea6607d6d2daa15`;
Racket output SHA-256 is
`591fb9b6ad1144d7a31d0a936bdb3f001bb13db56e32ef654cdee9e4d74b97a6`;
rival output SHA-256 is
`a7186b57f0413fc96479ea29807b509ff2f420b1c024928f002e9a42d6745def`.
The successful replay console is
`checks/audit/05cfa1aabb8a/probe/console-success.log`.

The isolated native audit in
`checks/audit/05cfa1aabb8a-native/result.json` found no task-local tests and
failed the strict semantic gate because no semantic contract is declared. That
native finding alone is not the defect claim; the explicit baseline-fitting
rival and accepted intervention above reproduce the teaching shortcut.

A repair should generate same-palette wrong-shape decoys, declare the palette-only
rival, and require each exported lesson to refute it. No repair was applied in
this audit-only section.
